title: Free Household Hazardous Waste and Bulky Waste Collection Set for Saturday, Dec. 5 at El Metro Park & Ride
excerpt: The City of Laredo Solid Waste Services will hold a free Household Hazardous Waste and Bulky Waste Collection Event on Saturday, Dec. 5, from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. at the El Metro Park & Ride, 1800 Hillside Road.
content:
The City of Laredo Solid Waste Services will hold a free Household Hazardous Waste and Bulky Waste Collection Event on Saturday, Dec. 5, 2026, from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. at the El Metro Park & Ride, 1800 Hillside Road.

Residents can drop off electronics, cleaning products, paints, solvents and stains, pesticides, herbicides and insecticides, lithium batteries, car batteries and fluorescent light bulbs. Bulky items accepted include tires, up to four with no rims, mattresses and box springs, furniture, house appliances, exercise equipment, large toys, scrap metal and swing sets.

Household hazardous waste should never be placed in a regular trash cart, the department said, because improper disposal can cause fires and environmental pollution.

Yard waste, construction waste, commercial waste, medical waste, radioactive waste, ammunition and explosives, utility trailers, U-Haul cargo and loose trash will not be accepted.

For questions, call 956-796-1098 or 3-1-1.

Source: City of Laredo Solid Waste Services, Nov. 17, 2026.
